Achha naam keemti tel se behtar hai.
Ek prasann swabhaav sabse accha samaan hai.
Log ahankar ke uthle paani me doobte hain.
Nirasha ek daldal hai jo vicharon ko nigal leti hai.
Shaant aatma ek durg hai.
Jeevan ko saans se nahi, palon se maapo.
Shaant man shaant sansaar hai.
Daya samaj ki sone ki zanjeer hai.
Buddhi woh aag hai jo vicharak ko garmi deti hai.
Ek chatur chaal smarak se zyada chalti hai.
Dimaag wahi nark banata hai jisse woh darta hai.
Teekha jawab chatur ka kavach hota hai.
Bheetar dekho; khazana gahra hai.
Jis haath se khana khao, use hi mat kaato.
Buddhi komal rooh ka kavach hai.
Irshya vah zehar hai jo khud peeya jaye.
Ek prasann swabhaav sabse sakht toofaan ko jeetta hai.
Khamoshi mein teekhe vicharon ka toofan chhipa hota hai.
Sammelan sangeet ki aatma hai.
Buddhi ek shandar dimaag ki parchhayi hai.
Hum andar basne wali cheezon ko rokne ke liye deewar banate hain.
Baanta gaya dukh aadha bojh halka kar deta hai.
Bharosa ek baar banta hai aur hamesha ke liye kho jaata hai.
Man hi insaan ka maap hai.
Buddhi zinda dimaag ki chamak hai.
Samay sabhi cheezon mein sabse gyaani hai.
Gyan boyi gayi moorkhata ki fasal hai.
Dil jaane-pehchane sapnon mein panah dhoondhta hai.
Bhavnayein andar ke samrajya par raaj karti hain.
Shant darshak toofaan se pehle hava dekhta hai.
Shaant paani anant ko pratibimbabit kare.
Irshya doosro par teer chalaaye aur khud ko ghayal kare.
Hosh arajakta ke sath ek nazuk samjhauta hai.
Sabse gehre paani shant chalte hain, jaise chalak sadyantra.
Hum taaron se chalte hain, par andhere me thokar khate hain.
Bina pariksha ka man jangli pashu hai.
Ek chatur tippani jeebh par dhalas sona hai.
Log khoon se sona kharidte hain, par ahankar ke liye bechte hain.
Mahatwakanksha insaan ko apni barbaadi nahi dikhne deti.
Sabse chalak jaal banane wale ko hi pakad leta hai.
Ahankar se bharne par aatma ki naav chhed ho jaati hai.
Daya devataon ki asli mudra hai.
Khwahish insaan ko anjaane samandar paar karwa deti hai.
Man chhaaiyon ka rangmanch hai.
Dar kalpana ki jail hai.
Andhere se mat daro, taare dhundho.
Ek khushnuma mazak dukh ki sabse acchi dawa hai.
Saaf aasmaan ko hawa ki zaroorat nahi.
Atmavishwas me manav disha suchak tezi se ghoomta hai.
